patthana16.63:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassanasappaṭigho āsavavippayutto na sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na anidassanasappaṭigho āsavavippayutto na sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassanasappaṭigho āsavavippayutto na sāsavo ca na anidassanasappaṭigho āsavavippayutto na sāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
